LESSON: WHO IS CREATION

Grade: PP1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: GOD’S
Topic 1.1: Who is CREATION

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Who is CREATION. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Where does He live?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate God’s love as the (7 Lessons) promote personal relationship with Him.
2. identify God as his/her heavenly Father.
3. respect God as the Father of mankind,
4. appreciate God as the Sole Creator and Heavenly Father for personal development. thanksgiving songs to God as their sole Creator and Heavenly Father.(Genesis 1:27)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. demonstrate God’s love as the (7 Lessons) promote personal relationship with Him.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate God’s love as the (7 Lessons) promote personal relationship with Him. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. identify God as his/her heavenly Father.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify God as his/her heavenly Father. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. respect God as the Father of mankind,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to respect God as the Father of mankind,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate God as the Sole Creator and Heavenly Father for personal development. thanksgiving songs to God as their sole Creator and Heavenly Father.(Genesis 1:27)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate God as the Sole Creator and Heavenly Father for personal development. thanksgiving songs to God as their sole Creator and Heavenly Father.(Genesis 1:27). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Who is CREATION.
2. Explain Who is CREATION to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should mention their names 1.
4. Show that you can: demonstrate God’s love as the (7 Lessons) promote personal relationship with Him.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Who is CREATION. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Where does He live?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Mention their names 1.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. demonstrate God’s love as the (7 Lessons) promote personal relationship with Him.
2. identify God as his/her heavenly Father.
3. respect God as the Father of mankind,
4. appreciate God as the Sole Creator and Heavenly Father for personal development. thanksgiving songs to God as their sole Creator and Heavenly Father.(Genesis 1:27)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
